title: Concept: pip configuration trusts a host without TLS verification
description: pip.conf declares a `trusted-host` entry, for which certificate validation is skipped, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The transport no longer proves which server answered, so the index identity rests on the network path only.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pip.conf (pypi).
risk: The transport no longer proves which server answered, so the index identity rests on the network path only.
